Shapes & mirror

Mirror lines run through the middle of the camera frame. They work for the brush, eraser and shapes. Hold Shift for straight 45° lines and perfect squares or circles.

Keyboard shortcuts

BBrush EEraser GFill IColor picker (or Alt + click with the brush) SpacePlay / stop ← →Previous / next frame NBlank frame after this one DDuplicate frame DeleteDelete frame [ ]Hold the frame shorter / longer − =Smaller / bigger brush OOnion skin on / off Shift LLoop L ULine / rectangle (Shift U: ellipse) MSelect area HMirror view (only the view is flipped) Shift H / V / RFlip ↔ / flip ↕ / rotate the selection, or the whole cel Ctrl C X VCopy / cut / paste (pictures from other programs too) Ctrl Shift C / VCopy frame / paste it after this one 0 · 1Fit to screen · zoom 100% Ctrl ZUndo Ctrl Shift ZRedo (or Ctrl Y) Shift NNew layer ↑ ↓Layer above / below Home EndFirst / last frame Ctrl SSave right now Drag filesPictures onto the canvas (Alt: as an image layer), several pictures become frames; animation and .aseprite files onto the desktop F11Full screen Shift GGradient KCamera key on this frame (select the Camera row to drag the camera) WheelZoom at the cursor (or Num + Num −), 0 to fit the camera Hold wheelDrag to move around the canvas

Drag frame numbers in the timeline to reorder frames, double-click a layer name to rename it, and right-click the palette to edit it. Each animation saves to its own file on its own. Several files can be open at once: switch between them on the taskbar, and the star in the top left takes you back to the desktop.
